# How much time do children spend in different social states?
```{r load segments data}
segments_data <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/interaction_segments.csv") %>%
    mutate(age = scale(age_at_recording),
         child_id = as.character(child_id),
         interaction_type = factor(interaction_type, 
                                   levels = c("Alone", "Available", "Interacting")))

# Process for plotting points: One value per child per social state
segments_data_p <- segments_data %>%
  group_by(child_id) %>%
  # Calculate total seconds recorded for the child across ALL states
  mutate(child_total_sec = sum(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(child_id, interaction_type) %>%
  summarise(
    # Total duration for this child in minutes (for point size)
    duration = max(child_total_sec) / 60, 
    # Proportion: (Sum of seconds in THIS state) / (Total seconds for THIS child)
    prop = sum(duration_sec) / max(child_total_sec),
    # Age at first recording
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r run segments model}
bm_segments <- brm(
  interaction_type | weights(duration_sec,scale = TRUE) ~ age + (1 | child_id),
  family = categorical(),
  data = segments_data,
  cores = 4,
  chains = 4,
  threads = threading(8), 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r prepare segments plotting}
ndata_segments <- segments_data %>%
  distinct(age, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(age, age_at_recording) %>%
  # This is useful for generating predictions for every age-category pair
  expand_grid(interaction_type = unique(segments_data$interaction_type))


post_segments <- fitted(bm_segments, newdata = ndata_segments, re_formula = NA) %>%
  # Convert the predictions into a tibble for easier manipulation
  as_tibble() %>%
  # Add the ndata columns (age, age_at_recording, category) alongside predictions
  bind_cols(ndata_segments) %>%
  select(-interaction_type) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(contains("P(Y = ")),
    names_to = "category2",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) %>%
  separate(category2, into = c("type", "interaction_type"), sep = " = ") %>%
  mutate(interaction_type = str_remove(interaction_type, "\\)"),
         type = recode(type,
           "Estimate.P(Y"    = "estimate",
           "Est.Error.P(Y"   = "est.error",
           "Q2.5.P(Y"        = "lci",
           "Q97.5.P(Y"       = "uci"
         )) %>%
  
  distinct(age_at_recording, type, interaction_type, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = estimate)
```

```{r plot segments model}
p_00 <- ggplot() +
  # Raw data points (using size for duration as in the original)
  geom_point(data = segments_data_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = prop, size = duration, col = interaction_type), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_segments, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = lci, ymax = uci, fill = interaction_type), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = post_segments, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = estimate, col = interaction_type), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_size(name = "Total recording\nduration (in min)") +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  ylab("Time spent in Social State (%)") +
  xlab("Age (Years)") +
  theme_minimal()

p_00
```

```{r segment model summary}
summary(bm_segments)
```

```{r marginal effects segments model}
# 1. Create two tiny dataframes: one at Age X and one at Age X + 1
# We use the mean age (0) as the reference point
nd_base <- tibble(age = 0)
nd_plus <- tibble(age = 1) 

# 2. Get posterior predicted probabilities for both (returns a Draw x Category matrix)
# 're_formula = NA' ignores individual child differences to get the population average
epred_base <- posterior_epred(bm_segments, newdata = nd_base, re_formula = NA)[,1,]
epred_plus <- posterior_epred(bm_segments, newdata = nd_plus, re_formula = NA)[,1,]

# 3. Subtract them to get the "Absolute Change in Probability per 1 SD of Age"
abs_slopes_draws <- epred_plus - epred_base

# 4. Summarize the results into a table
absolute_slopes_table <- as_tibble(abs_slopes_draws) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "social_state", values_to = "slope") %>%
  group_by(social_state) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_slope = mean(slope),
    lower_95 = quantile(slope, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(slope, 0.975),
    prob_direction = if_else(mean_slope > 0, mean(slope > 0), mean(slope < 0))
  )

print(absolute_slopes_table)
```
```{r get exact estimates segments model}
# 1. Create a data for Age 3 and Age 6.
age_3_scaled <- (3 - age_mean) / age_sd
age_6_scaled <- (6 - age_mean) / age_sd

ndata <- data.frame(age = c(age_3_scaled, age_6_scaled))

# 2. Get the predicted probabilities
# re_formula = NA gives the population-level average (the trend line)
# probs = c(0.025, 0.975) gives the 95% Credible Interval
final_preds_segments <- fitted(bm_segments, newdata = ndata, re_formula = NA, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

print(final_preds_segments)
```

# How much speech does the key child produce?
## Part 1
```{r loads kcs data}
kcs_data <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/02_kcs_summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    age = scale(age_at_recording),
    speech_activity_percent = pmin(pmax(speech_activity_percent, 0), 1),
    child_id = as.character(child_id))

# Process for plotting points: One value per child and social state
kcs_data_p <- kcs_data %>%
  # Calculate absolute speech minutes per segment
  mutate(speech_minutes = speech_activity_percent * segment_duration_minutes) %>%
  group_by(child_id, interaction_type) %>%
  summarize(
    # Get the age of the first recording for this child
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording),
    # Sum total duration and total speech minutes
    total_segment_minutes = sum(segment_duration_minutes),
    total_speech_minutes = sum(kchi_speech_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate the aggregate percentage for the child in this state
    total_speech_activity = total_speech_minutes / total_segment_minutes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Check data distribution}
ggplot(kcs_data, aes(x = speech_activity_percent)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#691633", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Key Child Speech",
       subtitle = "Looking for spikes at 0 (silence) and 1 (continuous speech)",
       x = "Speech Activity (%)", y = "Frequency (Segments)") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r run kcs model}
bm_kcs <- brm(
  speech_activity_percent | weights(segment_duration_minutes,scale = TRUE)  ~ age * interaction_type + (1 + interaction_type | child_id),
  data = kcs_data,
  family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  init = 0,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 8000,
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8), 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
)
```

```{r prepare kcs plotting}
ndata_kcs <- kcs_data%>%
  distinct(age, .keep_all = T)%>%
  select(age, age_at_recording)%>%
  expand_grid(interaction_type = unique(kcs_data$interaction_type))

post_kcs <- fitted(bm_kcs, newdata = ndata_kcs, re_formula = NA)%>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_kcs)
```

```{r plot kcs model}
p_01 <- ggplot() +
  # Raw data points
  geom_point(data = kcs_data_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = total_speech_activity, size = total_segment_minutes, col = interaction_type), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_kcs, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5, fill = interaction_type), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = post_kcs, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate, col = interaction_type), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_size(name = "Total recording\nduration (in min)") +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  ylab("Key Child Speech (%)") +
  xlab("Age (Years)") +
  theme_minimal()
p_01
```

```{r kcs model summary}
summary(bm_kcs)
```

```{r marginal effects kcs model}
# absolute slope for age within each social state
kcs_slopes <- emtrends(bm_kcs, ~ interaction_type, var = "age")
print(kcs_slopes)
```

```{r get exact estimates kcs model}
ndata_kcs <- expand.grid(
  age = c(age_3_scaled, age_6_scaled),
  interaction_type = c("Alone", "Available", "Interacting")
)

# Get predicted speech activity (%)
# re_formula = NA gives the population trend
kcs_preds <- fitted(bm_kcs, newdata = ndata_kcs, re_formula = NA, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

kcs_results <- cbind(ndata_kcs, as.data.frame(kcs_preds))
print(kcs_results)
```

## Part 2
```{r load absolute kcs data}
kcs_glob_data <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/02a_global_kcs_summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    child_id = as.character(child_id),
    age = scale(age_at_recording),
    speech_activity_percent = pmin(pmax(speech_activity_percent, 0), 1))

# Calculate scaling parameters from the RAW data to match the model
age_mean <- mean(kcs_glob_data$age_at_recording, na.rm = TRUE)
age_sd   <- sd(kcs_glob_data$age_at_recording, na.rm = TRUE)

# Add scaled age to the plotting points dataframe
kcs_glob_data_p <- kcs_glob_data %>%
  mutate(age = (age_at_recording - age_mean) / age_sd)
```

```{r check data distribution}
ggplot(kcs_glob_data, aes(x = speech_activity_percent)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#691633", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 20, fill = "#691633", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Global Speech Activity (%)", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r run kcs_glob model}
bm_glob_kcs <- brm(
  speech_activity_percent | weights(total_recording_minutes) ~ age,
  family = Beta(),
  data = kcs_glob_data,
  cores = 4, 
  chains = 4,
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r prepare kcs_glob plotting}
# Create a smooth range of ages for the prediction line
ndata_kcs_glob_data <- tibble(
  age_at_recording = seq(min(kcs_glob_data$age_at_recording), 
                         max(kcs_glob_data$age_at_recording), 
                         length.out = 100)
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Scale this sequence using the SAME mean/sd as the model data
    age = (age_at_recording - age_mean) / age_sd
  )

# Generate posterior predictions
post_kcs_glob_data <- fitted(bm_glob_kcs, newdata = ndata_kcs_glob_data, re_formula = NA) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_kcs_glob_data)
```

```{r plot kcs_glob model}
p_011 <- ggplot() +
  # 1. Individual child points (weighted by their total recording time)
  geom_point(data = kcs_glob_data_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = speech_activity_percent, size = total_recording_minutes), color = "#2D6A4F", alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_kcs_glob_data, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), fill = "#2D6A4F", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(data = post_kcs_glob_data, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate), color = "#2D6A4F", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) + # Adjusted limit based on typical KCS
  scale_size(name = "Total recording\nduration (in min)") +
  labs(y = "Key Child Speech (%)", 
       x = "Age (Years)") +
  theme_minimal()

p_011
```

```{r kcs_glob model summary}
summary(bm_glob_kcs)
```

```{r get exact estimates kcs_glob model}
# Create data for the target ages
ndata_glob <- data.frame(age = c(age_3_scaled, age_6_scaled))

# Get predicted global speech density (%)
glob_preds <- fitted(bm_glob_kcs, newdata = ndata_glob, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Combine for your paragraph
glob_results <- cbind(ndata_glob, as.data.frame(glob_preds))
print(glob_results)
```

# How much speech is the child exposed to? 
## Part 1
```{r loads kcds data}
cds_total_data <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/03_cds_summary.csv") %>%
  filter(exposure_type == "TOTAL") %>%
  mutate(
    interaction_type = factor(interaction_type, levels = c("Alone", "Available", "Interacting")),
    age = scale(age_at_recording),
    exposure_percent = pmin(pmax(exposure_percent, 0), 1),
    total_speech_minutes = total_speech_seconds / 60,
    child_id = as.character(child_id)
  )

# Process for plotting points: One value per child and social state
cds_data_p <- cds_total_data %>%
  # Calculate absolute exposure minutes per segment
  mutate(exposure_minutes = exposure_percent * segment_duration_minutes) %>%
  group_by(child_id, interaction_type) %>%
  summarise(
    # Take the age of the first recording
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Sum total duration and total exposure minutes
    total_segment_minutes = sum(segment_duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_exposure_minutes = sum(total_speech_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate the aggregate weighted percentage for this child in this state
    total_speech_exposure = total_exposure_minutes / total_segment_minutes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Check data distribution}
ggplot(cds_total_data, aes(x = exposure_percent)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#3D7B8E", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Speech Exposure",
       subtitle = "Looking for spikes at 0 (no exposure) and 1",
       x = "Exposure Percent (%)", y = "Frequency (Segments)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r run kcds model}
bm_cds <- brm(
  exposure_percent | weights(segment_duration_minutes, scale = TRUE) ~ age * interaction_type + (1 + interaction_type | child_id),
  family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
  data = cds_total_data,
  cores = 4,
  chains = 4,
  threads = threading(8), 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r prepare kcds plotting}
# Generate prediction grid
ndata_cds <- cds_total_data %>%
  distinct(age, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(age, age_at_recording) %>%
  expand_grid(
    interaction_type = levels(cds_total_data$interaction_type)
  )

post_cds <- fitted(bm_cds, newdata = ndata_cds, re_formula = NA) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_cds)
```

```{r plot kcds model}
p_03 <- ggplot() +
  # Points sized by recording duration
  geom_point(data = cds_data_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = total_speech_exposure, size = total_segment_minutes, col = interaction_type), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_cds, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5, fill = interaction_type), alpha = 0.1) +   # Mean Estimate Line
  geom_line(data = post_cds, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate, col = interaction_type), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Social State", values = c("Alone" = "#69777B", "Available" = "#8E7C3B", "Interacting" = "#691633")) +
  scale_size(name = "Total recording\nduration (in min)") +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  labs(y = "Speech Exposure (%)", x = "Age (Years)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

p_03
```

```{r kcds model summary}
summary(bm_cds)
```

```{r marginal effects kcds model}
# absolute slope for age within each social state
kcs_slopes <- emtrends(bm_cds, ~ interaction_type, var = "age")
print(kcs_slopes)
```

```{r get exact estimates kcds model}
ndata_kcds <- expand.grid(
  age = c(age_3_scaled, age_6_scaled),
  interaction_type = c("Alone", "Available", "Interacting")
)

# Get predicted speech activity (%)
# re_formula = NA gives the population trend
kcds_preds <- fitted(bm_cds, newdata = ndata_kcds, re_formula = NA, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

kcds_results <- cbind(ndata_kcds, as.data.frame(kcds_preds))
print(kcds_results)
```

# How is children’s conversational turn taking behavior characterized?
## Part 1
```{r load turn taking data}
turn_taking_raw <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/04_turn_taking_summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    age = scale(age_at_recording),
    child_id = as.character(child_id),
    total_successful_blocks = successful_initiations + successful_responses
  ) %>%
  # Add proportions and handle NAs (if no turns occurred in a segment)
  mutate(
    prop_initiation = if_else(total_successful_blocks > 0, 
                              successful_initiations / total_successful_blocks, 0),
    prop_response = if_else(total_successful_blocks > 0, 
                            successful_responses / total_successful_blocks, 0)
  )

# Process for plotting points: ONE point per child
turn_taking_p <- turn_taking_raw %>%
  group_by(child_id) %>%
  summarize(
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording),
    total_segment_minutes = sum(segment_duration_minutes),
    total_turns_sum = sum(total_turns),
    # Weighted average turns per minute
    avg_turns_per_minute = total_turns_sum / total_segment_minutes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r check data distribution}
ggplot(turn_taking_raw, aes(x = turns_per_minute)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                 bins = 30, 
                 fill = "steelblue", 
                 color = "white") +
  geom_density(color = "red", size = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Check for Bell-Curve Shape",
       x = "Turns per Minute",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r run turn taking model}
bm_turn_taking <- brm(
  bf(turns_per_minute | weights(segment_duration_minutes, scale = TRUE) ~ age + (1 | child_id),
     hu ~ age + (1 | child_id)), 
  family = hurdle_lognormal(), 
  data = turn_taking_raw,
  cores = 4,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20)
)
```

  

```{r prepare turn_taking plotting}
ndata_turn_taking <- tibble(
  # Create 100 points between the youngest and oldest child
  age_at_recording = seq(min(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording), 
                         max(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording), 
                         length.out = 100)
) %>%
  # 2. Scale these points using the Mean and SD of your REAL data 
  mutate(age_scaled = (age_at_recording - mean(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording))/sd(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording))

# 1. Generate Posterior Predictions
post_turn_taking <- as_tibble(fitted(
  bm_turn_taking, 
  newdata = ndata_turn_taking %>% rename(age = age_scaled), # Ensure column name matches model formula
  re_formula = NA
)) %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_turn_taking)
```

## Part 2
```{r load agency data}
# Create the long-format data for the model
turns_agency_long <- turn_taking_raw %>%
  # 1. Filter out segments where no turns happened to avoid 0/0 errors
  filter(total_successful_blocks > 0) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(prop_initiation, prop_response),
    names_to = "agency_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  # Safety clamp only, no statistical squeezing
  mutate(prop_adj = pmin(pmax(proportion, 0), 1))
```

```{r check data distirbution}
ggplot(turns_agency_long, aes(x = proportion, fill = agency_type)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~agency_type, labeller = as_labeller(c(
    "prop_initiation" = "Child-Led (Initiations)",
    "prop_response" = "Adult-Led (Responses)"
  ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("prop_initiation" = "#2E5A88", "prop_response" = "#B57B36")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Conversational Agency",
    subtitle = "Checking for spikes at 0 and 1 to decide between Beta and ZOIB",
    x = "Proportion of Exchanges",
    y = "Count of Segments"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r run agency model}
# Agency Model
bm_agency <- brm(
  prop_adj ~ age * agency_type + (1 | child_id),
  family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
  data = turns_agency_long,
  cores = 4, chains = 4,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r prepare agency plotting}
ndata_agency <- expand_grid(
  age_at_recording = seq(min(turns_agency_long$age_at_recording), 
                         max(turns_agency_long$age_at_recording), 
                         length.out = 100),
  agency_type = c("prop_initiation", "prop_response")
) %>%
  mutate(age = (age_at_recording - mean(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording))/sd(turn_taking_raw$age_at_recording))

# Posterior predictions
post_agency <- fitted(bm_agency, 
                      newdata = ndata_agency, 
                      re_formula = NA) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  # Bind the predictions (Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5) to our grid
  bind_cols(ndata_agency)

# Process for plotting points: one value per child per agency type
agency_p <- turn_taking_raw %>%
  filter(total_successful_blocks > 0) %>%
  group_by(child_id) %>%
  summarize(
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording),
    total_segment_minutes = sum(segment_duration_minutes),
    # Weighted proportions
    sum_init = sum(successful_initiations),
    sum_resp = sum(successful_responses),
    sum_total = sum(total_successful_blocks),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sum_init, sum_resp), 
               names_to = "agency_type", 
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_proportion = count / sum_total,
    agency_type = recode(agency_type, "sum_init" = "prop_initiation", "sum_resp" = "prop_response")
  )
```

```{r plot agency model}
p_022 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = agency_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = avg_proportion, color = agency_type, size = total_segment_minutes), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_agency, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5, fill = agency_type), alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = post_agency, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate, color = agency_type), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Conversational Block\nInitiation", 
                     values = c("prop_initiation" = "#691633", "prop_response" = "#D4A373"),
                     labels = c("Child-Led", "Adult-Led")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("prop_initiation" = "#691633", "prop_response" = "#D4A373"), guide = "none") +
  scale_size(name = "Total recording\nduration (in min)") +
  labs(y = "Conversational Block Initiation \nduring Interaction (%)", x = "Age (Years)") +
  theme_minimal()

p_022
```


## Part 3
```{r load turn duration data}
# Load the raw vocalization durations
turn_duration_raw <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/04b_turn_durations_summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    child_id = as.character(child_id),
    age = scale(as.numeric(age_at_recording))
  ) %>%
  # Filter out potential noise/extremely short segments
  filter(vocalization_duration_sec > 0.1)

turn_duration_p <- turn_duration_raw %>%
  group_by(child_id) %>%
  summarize(
    # Get the raw age for the x-axis
    age_at_recording = min(as.numeric(age_at_recording), na.rm = TRUE),
    # Calculate the average duration for this child
    avg_vocalization_duration = mean(vocalization_duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_vocalizations = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r check data distribution}
# Check the distribution
ggplot(turn_duration_raw, aes(x = vocalization_duration_sec)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#2E5A88", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Individual Child Turn Durations",
       x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r run turn duration model}
# Model: Does age predict the length of an individual vocalization?
bm_turn_duration <- brm(
  vocalization_duration_sec ~ age + (1 | child_id),
  family = lognormal(),
  data = turn_duration_raw,
  cores = 4, chains = 4,
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
)
```

```{r prepare turn duration plotting}
ndata_turn_duration <- tibble(
  age_at_recording = seq(min(as.numeric(turn_duration_raw$age_at_recording)), 
                         max(as.numeric(turn_duration_raw$age_at_recording)), 
                         length.out = 100)
) %>%
  mutate(age = (age_at_recording - mean(as.numeric(turn_duration_raw$age_at_recording))) / 
                 sd(as.numeric(turn_duration_raw$age_at_recording)))

# Generate predictions (back-transformed to seconds automatically by fitted())
post_turn_duration <- as_tibble(fitted(bm_turn_duration, newdata = ndata_turn_duration, re_formula = NA)) %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_turn_duration)
```

```{r plot turn duration model}
  geom_ribbon(data = post_turn_duration, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), alpha = 0.1, fill = "#691633") +
  geom_line(data = post_turn_duration, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate), linewidth = 1.2, color = "#691633") +
```

# How do environmental cues predict active social interaction?
```{r loads aspects data}
aspects_data <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/05_interaction_composition.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    age = (scale(as.numeric(age_at_recording))),
    child_id = as.character(child_id)
  )

aspects_data_m <- bind_rows(
  aspects_data %>% filter(
    has_cds == 1 & has_ohs == 0 & has_face == 0 & has_person == 0) %>% mutate(condition = "Only KCDS Present"),
  aspects_data %>% filter(
    (has_cds == 1 | has_ohs == 1) & has_face == 0 & has_person == 0) %>% mutate(condition = "Only Speech Present"),
  aspects_data %>% filter(
    has_cds == 0 & has_ohs == 0 & has_face == 1 & has_person == 0) %>% mutate(condition = "Only Face Present"),
  aspects_data %>% filter(
    has_cds == 0 & has_ohs == 0 & has_face == 0 & has_person == 1) %>% mutate(condition = "Only Person Present"),
) %>%
  group_by(child_id, condition) %>%
  summarize(
    age = min(age),
    age_at_recording = min(age_at_recording),
    n = n(),
    p = sum(is_interaction),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(aspects_data_m, "data/analysis_20260410_202054/05_interaction_composition_model.csv")

# Process for plotting points: one value per child per condition
aspects_data_p <- aspects_data_m %>%
  group_by(child_id, condition) %>%
  summarize(
    # Total trials (n) and total successes (p) across all recordings for this child
    total_n = sum(n),
    total_p = sum(p),
    prop = total_p / total_n,
    age_at_recording = age_at_recording,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r run aspects model}
bm_aspects <- brm(
  p | trials(n) ~ age * condition + (age | child_id),
  family = binomial(),
  data = aspects_data_m,
  cores = 4, 
  chains = 4, 
  threads = threading(8),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  iter = 8000,
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r prepare aspects plotting}
ndata_aspects <- expand_grid(
  condition = unique(aspects_data_m$condition),
  age = seq(min(aspects_data_m$age), max(aspects_data_m$age), length.out = 100)
) %>%
  mutate(n = 1)

# Get posterior predictions
post_aspects <- fitted(bm_aspects, newdata = ndata_aspects, re_formula = NA) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_cols(ndata_aspects) %>%
  # Convert back to raw age for the x-axis
  mutate(age_at_recording = age * sd(as.numeric(aspects_data$age_at_recording)) + 
                            mean(as.numeric(aspects_data$age_at_recording)))
```

```{r plot aspects model}
aspect_colors <- c(
  "Only Face Present"   = "#7D5BA6", 
  "Only KCDS Present"   = "#3D7B8E", 
  "Only Speech Present" = "#89CFF0",
  "Only Person Present" = "#D99F59"
)

aspect_colors <- c(
  "Only Face Present"   = "#F4A261", 
  "Only KCDS Present"   = "#89CFF0", 
  "Only Speech Present" = "#0F4C5C",
  "Only Person Present" = "#9B2226"
)

p_04 <- ggplot() +
  # 1. Plot empirical data points
  geom_point(data = aspects_data_p, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = prop, size = total_n, color = condition), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_ribbon(data = post_aspects, aes(x = age_at_recording, ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5, fill = condition), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = post_aspects, aes(x = age_at_recording, y = Estimate, color = condition), linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Social Cues", values = aspect_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Social Cues", values = aspect_colors) +
  scale_size(name = "Total observations\n(Frames)") +
  labs(y = "Probability of Frame\nbeing in 'Interacting' State (%)", 
       x = "Age (Years)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) + # Ensures the probability stays within [0,1]
  theme_minimal()

p_04
```

```{r plot gt vs prediction}
# Define video name
video_name <- "quantex_at_home_id254922_2022_04_12_01"

# Load ground truth
gt <- read_delim("data/00_interaction_segments_gt.csv", delim = ";")
pred <- read_csv("data/analysis_20260410_202054/interaction_segments.csv")

# Ground truth segments
gt_segments <- gt %>%
  filter(video_name == !!video_name) %>%
  mutate(
    start_sec = period_to_seconds(hms(start_time_sec)),
    end_sec   = period_to_seconds(hms(end_time_sec)),
    source = "Ground Truth"
  ) %>%
  select(interaction_type, start_sec, end_sec, source)

# Prediction segments
pred_segments <- pred %>%
  filter(video_name == !!video_name) %>%
  mutate(
    start_sec = start_time_sec,   # already in seconds
    end_sec   = end_time_sec,
    source = "Prediction",
    # optional: recode interaction_type to match GT if needed
    interaction_type = recode(interaction_type,
      "Co-present" = "available",
      "Interacting" = "interacting",
      "Alone" = "alone"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(interaction_type, start_sec, end_sec, source)

# Combine
plot_data <- bind_rows(gt_segments, pred_segments)
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos = case_when(
      source == "Ground Truth" ~ 0.1,  # slightly above 1
      source == "Prediction" ~ 0.2    # slightly below 1
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = start_sec, xend = end_sec,
                      y = y_pos, yend = y_pos,
                      color = interaction_type)) +
  geom_segment(size = 12, alpha = 0.8) +   # bar thickness
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.2),
    labels = c("Ground Truth", "Prediction"),
    limits = c(0, 1)  # very tight y-axis range
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "interacting" = "#BAA570",
    "alone"       = "#CBD2D5",
    "available"   = "#69777B"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (seconds)",
    y = "",
    color = "Interaction Type",
    title = paste("Ground Truth vs Predictions")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.3), expand = FALSE) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.40) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),       # remove y ticks
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), # remove horizontal grid
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
  )
```
